problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance at six distinct regional facilities.

The travel times between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility P to Q: 37.1 minutes
* Facility P to R: 49.0 minutes
* Facility P to S: 77.3 minutes
* Facility P to T: 66.9 minutes
* Facility P to U: 61.0 minutes
* Facility Q to R: 24.1 minutes
* Facility Q to S: 89.1 minutes
* Facility Q to T: 40.0 minutes
* Facility Q to U: 27.7 minutes
* Facility R to S: 74.0 minutes
* Facility R to T: 59.7 minutes
* Facility R to U: 16.3 minutes
* Facility S to T: 129.2 minutes
* Facility S to U: 89.0 minutes
* Facility T to U: 52.4 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the technician to service each facility precisely once, concluding the circuit at the initial departure point.
